skill.displayName: 标讯 · 广东招标中标与招投标数据查询

llm.summary: This is a disclosed procurement-data lookup skill, with opt-in account setup that may store an API key locally and send a hashed device identifier.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses external REST APIs, reads ZLBX_API_KEY or ~/.zlbx/config.json, and only enters auto-registration if no key exists; the device-feature collection is disclosed and requires user consent.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown documentation and references only; no executable payloads, dependencies, tool wrappers, scheduled jobs, or install-time scripts were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill is mostly scoped to tender lookup and related analysis, but documentation has reliability issues: default region is inconsistent in one general section versus the Guangdong-specific section, and some amount-unit/parameter notes conflict.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: After opt-in auto-registration, it writes the returned API key to ~/.zlbx/config.json and reuses it for future calls; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should understand it is local credential persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The procurement, company, market, account, and contact-query capabilities fit the stated Guangdong tender-search purpose; contact data is handled according to the service response and the skill tells agents not to bypass masking or bulk-export contacts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be comfortable with the service reading or creating a ZLBX API key, storing it in ~/.zlbx/config.json, and, if you opt into automatic registration, sending platform, CPU architecture, and a hashed MAC address to the vendor for trial-account de-duplication. For exact searches, especially company-group analysis or amount filters, check the stated query scope and units in the response.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: Automatic registration and local API-key storage are artifact-backed, but they are tied to service authentication, triggered only when no key is configured, and gated by user consent before registration.
[SDI-2] expected: The device features are limited to platform, architecture, and a SHA-256 MAC hash for trial de-duplication; this is privacy-sensitive but disclosed and opt-in.
[E1] expected: Outbound transmission occurs to the documented registration endpoint for account creation; the artifact does not show hidden or unrelated exfiltration.
[RA2] expected: Session persistence is limited to the service API key in ~/.zlbx/config.json; no broader agent persistence, hooks, services, or memory poisoning were found.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The scanner correctly points to documentation contradictions on regional defaults and some amount-unit/parameter guidance; these are accuracy and user-control concerns, not evidence of malicious behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Automatic expansion from a company name to related entities supports group-level procurement analysis, but users should verify the matched entities for precise or paid analysis.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only documentation is consistent with a China/Guangdong procurement workflow and is not a security issue by itself.
